records.summary: Rewrote the 10.1 AI/ML scale-up sequence diagram in both locales. records.summary: The write-pipeline pseudocode read the dedup marker only by (tenant, source, event_id) and rejected only strictly-older source_version, so a different event_id carrying the same (tenant, source, entity, version) with a different payload fell into the upsert branch and could overwrite already-published history; the marker's digest check also did not bind envelope/version. The transactional-outbox guidance (at-least-once delivery requires idempotent, dedup-tracked consumers; FIFO for exactly-once+ordering) supports making exact retries idempotent and conflicting envelopes rejected.
